security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first Clash Verge / mihomo routing workbench
bundle.longDescription: Clash RuleVis is a local-first visual routing workbench for Clash Verge and mihomo. It reads the local controller, shows live connections, manages nodes, exits, chains and rules, validates the generated YAML with mihomo, and exports safely without modifying Verge profiles.
